title: Resolve medium/low documentation drift
description:
**Dimension: doc-drift · 17 findings (12 medium, 5 low)** — see report §doc-drift (the 3 high items are filed separately).

Bring documentation back in line with code.

Medium:
- `CLAUDE.md` — "AARCH64" listed as supported SIMD target but only TODO stubs exist; correct the parenthetical.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md:43` — project tree lists 3 crates; add `gf2-algebra`, `gf2-sim`, `gf2-kernels-hip`, `proofs/`, `dev/`.
- `crates/gf2-algebra/README.md:84` — "16 lanes per u64-pair" for `Packed7` (it is a single u64); fix to "16 lanes per u64".
- `README.md:132` — `cargo test --workspace --all-features --release` should be `cargo nextest run ... --profile ci` (5 s per-test note).
- `CONTRIBUTING.md:28,31,222` — three `cargo test` invocations missing `--release`/nextest; fix all three.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md:139` — doc example `use gf2::BitVec` → `use gf2_core::BitVec`.
- `crates/gf2-algebra/src/permanent/mod.rs:15` — "F_5 covers n <= Packed5::LANES = 64" → n <= 63.
- `crates/gf2-algebra/src/permanent/bipedal5.rs:8,25` — single-word limit stated as n <= LANES = 64 → n <= 63.
- `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/lib.rs:9` — "AVX-512F (experimental)" but all AVX-512 fns are `unimplemented!()` stubs; correct the claim.
- `docs/presentations/ae82bd73-.../talk.html:125` — slide 8 "proven on the FiniteField trait" → Mathlib CommRing/ZMod 3 (Charon binding descoped).
- `docs/presentations/6efb756b-.../talk.html` — slides 9/11/28 cite private/`pub(crate)` paths as public API; annotate or replace.

Low:
- `crates/gf2-algebra/src/lib.rs:15` — crate docs embed internal wave/task designators (W2/W4-T18 etc.); remove from cargo-doc-visible entry point.
- `README.md` — features table omits `gf2-coding` default-on `sim-observability`; add row (and to crate README).
- `docs/presentations/6efb756b-.../talk.html:362` — slide 26 stale `cargo test` cmd + stale 2816 test count.
- `crates/gf2-sim/src/frame_sim.rs:17` — "not yet on main" comment stale (landed db9836e4); state actual reason only.
- `crates/gf2-core/src/compute/cpu.rs:101` — bare `// TODO: parallel version`; implement under `#[cfg(feature="parallel")]` or reference a JIT issue id.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Every listed site corrected; each claim verified against current code before edit (no new drift).
- [hard] The `compute/cpu.rs` TODO is either implemented or replaced with a traceable JIT reference (not left bare).
- [hard] `cargo fmt`/`cargo doc --no-deps` clean for touched Rust files.
